entries.gap: Verilator does not trace a signal whose name starts with an underscore, unless --trace-underscore is given.
entries.symptom: A VCD of a gate-level or generated netlist (net names such as _0123_) has no activity for these nets. An activity or power estimate from it is too low, with no error.
entries.workaround: Give --trace-underscore. Check that the trace has the number of signals that the netlist has, before you use it.
entries.evidence: a 2-net test module: the net _hidden is in the VCD only with --trace-underscore
